_about: The games of projects/, in the order the site shows them: what /games/ (scripts/export-games.py) says of each. The screenshot is projects/<name>/screenshot.png. "check" is what scripts/check-games-in-browser.py expects of the web build: the scene it opens on, and after pressing the keys of "press", the scene it goes to ("then") or the actions the game saw ("actions").

games.name: robot
games.title: Robot
games.blurb: Godot's "Platformer 2D" demo, transcribed: slopes and ledges, a robot that runs, jumps twice and shoots, crawling enemies, coins, lifts, a pause menu.
games.controls: Arrows or A/D to run; Up, W or the joypad's A to jump (again in the air); Space, Z or Ctrl to shoot; Escape to pause.

games.name: arena
games.title: Arena
games.blurb: A one-on-one fighting game: two martial artists, punches and kicks with frame data, blocking, rounds on a clock. On one keyboard or over the network, with rollback.
games.controls: Player 1: A/D, W jump, S crouch, J punch, K kick. Player 2: the arrows, . punch, / kick. Hold away from the other to block.

games.name: chess
games.title: Chess
games.blurb: Chess with its whole rules written in the language: castling, en passant, promotion, check, mate, stalemate. The board shows where a picked piece may go.
games.controls: Click a piece, then a square (or the arrows and Enter). White first.

games.name: drift
games.title: Drift
games.blurb: A vertical shooter: waves of drones and tanks, a boss that turns red when angry, a high score kept between runs.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to fly; Space to fire.

games.name: keep
games.title: Keep
games.blurb: A top-down adventure through six rooms of a keep: slimes and bats, a sword, a key and a locked door, a switch that opens a gate elsewhere, a chest.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to walk; Space to swing the sword.

games.name: hopper
games.title: Hopper
games.blurb: A platformer: a world map and three levels, a block with a power-up, walkers to stomp, pits, a checkpoint, spikes, a flag.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD; Space, Z or X to jump. On the map, jump enters a level.

games.name: towers
games.title: Towers
games.blurb: A tower defense: turrets that shoot the nearest dino, dinos down a road in waves, gold and a base to keep. Alone or two builders over the network.
games.controls: The mouse (or the arrows) points, click or Enter builds; 1 and 2 choose the turret; click a turret to upgrade it.

games.name: creeps
games.title: Creeps
games.blurb: Godot's "Dodge the Creeps" tutorial game, transcribed: creeps from the border at random speeds, a point a second.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to move; Space or Enter to start.

games.name: pong
games.title: Pong
games.blurb: Godot's own Pong demo, transcribed tag for node: two paddles and a ball. On one keyboard or over the network.
games.controls: W/S for the left paddle, the arrows for the right one.
